title: Bug 642180: DE report 11015 Export Business Data fails when scheduled via Job Queue: Client callbacks are not supported
summary: Report 11015 Export Business Data now stores generated ZIP files in the Report Inbox when scheduled via Job Queue instead of attempting a client callback that fails in background sessions.
key_points: Scheduled Job Queue runs failed because the report pushed the ZIP to the client, which background sessions cannot do
In background sessions with no GUI, the ZIP is now stored in the Report Inbox
Users download scheduled exports from the Report Inbox
Running the report interactively still downloads the ZIP directly
Matches how scheduled layout reports already behave
